info.title: AFRICLUB supporter membership gateway
info.description: Disabled isolated-staging native-bearer candidate. No browser cookie/CORS interface, payment execution, membership grant at checkout, automatic write retry or atomic cross-database revocation. All actions require current authentication. No server URLs are shipped.

get.summary: Read current owned membership separately from historical receipts

parameters.name: X-Africlub-History-Cursor
parameters.description: Owner-bound page selector; not a credential. Never log or persist. Only this list endpoint accepts it.

200.description: Fixed 20-row no-store live history page. Never a wallet or current entitlement.
No-store owned receipt envelope. Does not require a new checkout snapshot.

SupporterBearer.bearerFormat: AFRICLUB native opaque session UUID + 32-byte base64url secret

NativeClient.name: X-AFRICLUB-Client
NativeClient.description: Native transport marker, not an authentication credential.

ExpectedSession.name: X-AFRICLUB-Session
ExpectedSession.description: Must match the currently verified bearer session. Never an identity grant.

RequestKey.name: Idempotency-Key
RequestKey.description: Persist before POST. Reuse this exact key and canonical operation payload after an unknown outcome.

HandoffStatus.description: Current/reserve always return mayOpenDialer=false. Only the first successfully observed claim response can return true; replay never regrants. Neither a claim nor this permission is payment confirmation. A pending server marker survives device-data loss.

CurrentMembership.description: Point-in-time owned read. Suspension/expiry have precedence over an old verified receipt. isActive is true only for active state with a complete current verified term. It is not authority for subsequent mutations.
